steps.text: Bloodied. Torn. Pierced.
Us. Enemies. People.
Wailing, screaming, groaning.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You have a question. Ask.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Doctor... is this your first time seeing Rosmontis fight?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I know it's hard to watch, but—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'll handle it. You go tend to the wounded enemies who can't fight anymore. Also, among them are communications personnel relaying orders and intelligence.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If they're allowed to escape, it puts our whole operation at risk.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...Roger.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Fourteen.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: People, please... let me through!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What happened here? I just finished handling the...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Doctor, did you just call me?

options: Who sent you out to fight?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor!

options: You should not have to suffer through this.
...Why would they let you do this?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I did.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I did. I chose to fight. I want to fight.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: There are some feelings I can only experience on the battlefield.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Protecting my friends and family is the only way I can feel complete.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Rhodes Island needs me.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: The world is calling my name, to prevent more people like me from coming into it.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Does death care that I am a child?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Would war or disease spare someone because they are a child?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: When Amiya or I stand on the battlefield... who looks at us and thinks 'children?'

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: We're 'monsters,' aren't we, Doctor?

options: That's just how you see yourself.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No, Doctor.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It doesn't matter what I am.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I just want to make a difference, with my family.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Do you know Scout?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Do you know Ace?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ..It's already been a few days since I watched any of their materials.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I've forgotten a lot.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But I only forgot. I'm not like you, Doctor, who threw away everything.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No, I didn't mean that. But you get it, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I get it. But just... don't say it like that.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Mm... Fine.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I've lost bits and pieces of things. Lots of pictures and words.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Those feelings... feelings I can't say, only Amiya can understand...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But they never truly left me.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Doctor... I feel like you're complicated.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Even more complicated than they say.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: They say I'm complicated too. Some of them are scared of me. Some of them say I shouldn't be like this.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But they don't know why I'm like this. They don't know what I've been through.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Why does my heart suddenly ache? Why do I want to cry, now of all times?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Even though I can't remember anything... why are my eyes still sore? Why are my lips dry?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Who left a stain in the corridor, and why hasn't it been cleaned? Why do I feel worried when I break a vase, but also strangely happy?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Why do I feel disgust from looking at flowers, but wonder from looking at bugs?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: What happened during all that time I can no longer remember? Why do these emotions keep welling up within me?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Every operator I feel has their own unique differences.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: And when I lose them, those feelings also disappear.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But why...? Why do we even have emotions?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Why do my tears keep flowing even when I can't even feel anymore?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Didn't I already forget everything?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But Rosmontis never wanted me to take her feelings away.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: These sudden surges of emotion belong to her, no matter what they are.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...They belong only to Rosmontis.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't interfere with them. As long as Rosmontis still has hope somewhere inside her... I won't do that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Because it's up to her to choose what to do. She can also choose to forget.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: To truly forget.

options: I don't know that much about her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}... Rhodes Island has a strict screening process for our operators.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Many of them apply for combat roles, and we reject most of those. We look at lots of different metrics to decide if an operator is fit for combat.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Combat ability, tactical aptitude, discipline, and physical fitness are all important parameters, but that barely scratches the surface.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: People often have difficulty trusting one another when they're on an actual mission.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis is here because she trusts in our orders and objectives, and we trust in her abilities and judgment.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please believe in me, Doctor. No, believe in us...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You'll slowly begin to see... the colors of her emotions.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Doctor. Thank you for fighting alongside Blaze.

options: You don't have to thank me.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Blaze needs more people fighting alongside her. And I want to see her smile.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I want to see you too. I want to see the one Ace and Scout always talked about.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Here you are.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...She uses heavy machinery to quickly and effectively destroy the enemy, while at the same time exhibiting astonishing self-control and adaptiveness.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rosmontis is one of Rhodes Island's greatest annihilation specialists.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As such, the way she treats people and the way she speaks may worry you. The way she fights and its contrast with her appearance, is indeed very cruel.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Blaze running around with her chainsaw may be easier to accept, but the destruction of when Rosmontis takes the field is much harder to stomach.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If it will help you sleep at night, I can make you a promise. If it will help at all.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Rosmontis almost never kills. Though her tactics seems to singularly aim for that outcome, she actually focuses on disabling the enemy's combat abilities.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Take the last battle, for example, all the enemies were disarmed, and not a single one died to Rosmontis's attacks.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She also has much more control over her weapons than she once did.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Of course, whether or not we can keep the prisoners alive depends entirely on our ability to destroy Reunion's leadership. Only then will we be able to send rescue teams into the core city.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But sometimes, we must use lethal force in order to accomplish our goals. Some loss of life is inevitable.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You still look disturbed. Is this all beyond your ability to accept?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You might not be able to accept the truth either.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Her terrifying Originium Arts and incredible perception are not the only reasons why Rosmontis is an elite operator.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Rosmontis demonstrates these qualities because she became an elite operator.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We made our judgment not on whether to send her to battle, but how disastrous the consequences might be if we didn't let her become a fighter like this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Worst case scenario, her Arts leak out from her body and push her to kill, subconsciously or otherwise.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Humans killing each other has become the normal state of things. Even so, most people still hold their weapons and staves themselves.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Whether or not someone who has lost her sense of self can still be called a person is another topic I'm not interested in discussing. But humanity grapples with the extent and manifestation of this problem.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'When you deprive a human being of her sentience, what is left? What is created?'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'When that creation deprives us of our lives, who is at fault?'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The one who created the weapon, the one who used the weapon, or the one we treat as a weapon?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As we move on to the next battle, I may be able to teach you more.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: By the way, on the issue of her age...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya puts on an air of maturity that may have you fooled. Maybe, maybe not.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A young creature known as a deadly weapon won't be seen as an ordinary child just because she looks young.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Not to mention all that they've been through.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Take what you need. It's time to head to the surface.

options: What about Amiya? Is she a weapon too?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You can ask her yourself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is something you should hear from her.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Kal'tsit! Stop right there!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Warfarin, I was just leaving. Whatever it is, make it quick.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: You know the prophecy, don't you? Yes, there's nothing you don't know.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Prophecy?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Is that not why you allowed Amiya to go?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya is the commander of this operation, as well as the one who suggested it.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: But as young as Amiya is, how can she command—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Warfarin, how long has it been since we left Kazdel?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Be precise, or I'm leaving.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: ...Two months?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Warfarin... stop joking around.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I know what you mean. She's grown up.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes, Warfarin. Time flies.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Age progression in Cautuses and Vampires is radically different. It has been three years since we left Kazdel.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It may feel like a short time for you, but Amiya has matured a lot.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Answer my first question. The prophecy.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...'The last Wendigo will die at the hands of the Lord of Fiends?'

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Correct. I'm familiar with that guerilla group, and their leader. I'm certain it's him.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The original phrasing of the prophecy was 'The son of Hor-Tekrz, traitor to Sarkaz and disreputable end of the bloodline, will be executed by the Lord of Sarkaz.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Some prophecy. Whether or not there's any extension of their 'bloodline,' there are still many Wendigos living their lives in Columbia and Ursus.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...That is, if a few dozen can be called 'many.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And, considering the context of the time, you should view it as a threat. Many people did not want to see the Wendigos leave Kazdel.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: It wasn't either of us who said it. And since you still remember it, you must have found it important. No?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Are you getting old? Since when do you believe in 'prophecies' and Sarkaz witchcraft?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: —Old? M-Me?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I contracted Oripathy. Death is always here with me, waiting for the right time to strike. Warfarin, my life is no doubt much shorter than you think.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Must we be so morbid? I'm not your little girl Closure. I won't let you keep skirting the topic.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The issue you raised is quite morbid.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: ...Never mind.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Hear me, Kal'tsit, the others may not say as much to you, but I will.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: He is one of the very few left among us. I am no bleeding heart, no goodly busybody, but... we are Sarkaz.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I am a Vampire, and the old man is a Wendigo, but we are the same.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: This world is a tough place for Sarkaz. I hope he can return to Kazdel, if possible. Or come with us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm not, Warfarin. I'm not Sarkaz.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: So you refuse?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'll do what I can.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Even I remember him, Warfarin.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Your promise is stronger than anything.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Don't get your hopes up that this will be easy.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: But this time, you'll be there. As long as Dr. Kal'tsit makes her best effort, I'll accept the outcome.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Maybe you haven't heard, but your proposal came too late. Some things have already unfolded, and rather unfortunately.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Some time ago, an Infected clinic in Chernobog called 'Azazel' traded information with us. I learned some more information about the Wendigo in Reunion's service.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What's more, and you should know this well, anyone who stands against the most brutal blade in Ursus will soon learn whether it tastes of salt or rust.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Nobody should knowingly place our operators in danger.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Some patients' days are numbered, but that number depends on the doctor treating them. It's all up to us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...It's all up to us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And I told you before... You may have forgotten.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I won't discipline you for it, but I may do something to put an end to it once and for all.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You are not to say I'm frightening, Warfarin. We've been over this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do not, under any circumstances, even at Rhodes Island, speak of 'the Lord of Fiends.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ever.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All hands, at ease!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis... am I getting this right?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Hm. Yes. I felt it too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, something unexpected here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not totally sure, but...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The core city might be... slowing down?
